title: Dual-Career Household Optimizer
description: Port of ApexLogics Apex #92 (AL-99) Dual-Career Household Optimizer into the AINumbers chaingraph shape. Three coupled legs in one pass: childcare break-even (total childcare cost, the gross salary at which a partner's after-tax contribution covers it, the partner's net contribution, and household after-tax income with both working versus one); sabbatical true cost (direct income lost over the months out, lost employer 401k match on it, and a 10-year compounding opportunity cost of the reduced contribution track net of the direct loss already counted); and relocation (nominal household change plus a cost-of-living-adjusted restatement of the destination household in origin dollars, with a 3-months-per-$10k heuristic re-employment break-even for the lower earner's cut). Tax at or above 100%, a zero-current household, or a zero destination COL return null legs with a DIV_ZERO_GUARD flag instead of the page's Infinity/NaN. Port provenance: Apex page https://apexlogics.org/tools/92-dual-career-household-optimizer/ fetched 2026-10-13T20:56:01-04:00 (53859 bytes, sha256 b0e6c6712213c422910aa6659a4bfb18d4f5e96922e7b9837b49d473d88ae79a), tasking APEXPORT-92 (GRADES PASS-PENDING-XV 2026-10-14; Builder-verifies-at-land 22/22 fixture vectors per Tim 2026-10-18T21:20Z), landed by APEX-PORT-92-LAND-1 on 2026-10-19. The city COL index is the Apex page's own select table (UNGROUNDED, user-overridable); the BLS CES 2024 banner vintage is informational only (UNGROUNDED-1 per payload CITES.md) and no numeric vintage constant enters the arithmetic (payload DIFFERS.md Rows 1-3).

partnerASalary.description: Partner A gross salary, USD/yr. Apex control partnerASalary, default 110000.

partnerBSalary.description: Partner B gross salary, USD/yr. Apex control partnerBSalary, default 75000.

combinedTaxRate.description: Combined federal effective tax rate, percent. Apex control combinedTaxRate, default 28. User-supplied; no statutory table is embedded.

annualChildcareCost.description: Annual childcare cost per child, USD/yr. Apex control annualChildcareCost, default 25000 (an infant-center hint; the CCAoA 2024 all-modality national average is $13,128; a different statistic). User-overridable.

numChildren.description: Number of children in childcare. Apex control numChildren, default 1.

sabbaticalSalary.description: Stepping-down partner salary, USD/yr. Apex control sabbaticalSalary, default 95000.

sabbaticalReduction.description: Work reduction, percent (100 = full stop). Apex control sabbaticalReduction, default 100.

sabbaticalMonths.description: Sabbatical duration, months. Apex control sabbaticalMonths, default 12.

match401k.description: Employer 401k match, percent of salary. Apex control match401k, default 4.

incomeGrowthRate.description: Annual income growth rate, percent, for the 10-year opportunity-cost leg. Apex control incomeGrowthRate, default 3.

geoACurrentSalary.description: Partner A current salary, USD/yr. Apex control geoACurrentSalary, default 110000.

geoANewSalary.description: Partner A post-move salary, USD/yr. Apex control geoANewSalary, default 120000.

geoBCurrentSalary.description: Partner B current salary, USD/yr. Apex control geoBCurrentSalary, default 75000.

geoBNewSalary.description: Partner B expected post-move salary, USD/yr (0 = no job lined up). Apex control geoBNewSalary, default 65000.

geoOriginCity.description: Origin city COL index (NYC = 100). Apex control geoOriginCity, default 100. Apex-internal index; see the manifest description UNGROUNDED note.

geoDestCity.description: Destination city COL index. Apex control geoDestCity, default 75 (Chicago). Apex-internal index; see the manifest description UNGROUNDED note.

asOf.description: Explicit determinism parameter (ISO date/datetime). The Apex page stamps payloads with new Date() at export time; the kernel never reads the clock (APEXPORT-110B pattern).

mcp_tool_definition.name: dual_career_optimizer
mcp_tool_definition.description: Dual-career household optimizer ported from ApexLogics Apex #92 (AL-99): childcare break-even salary and household net under both-working versus one-stops, sabbatical true cost with a 10-year compounding opportunity leg, and a COL-adjusted relocation comparison with a months-per-$10k re-employment break-even. Guarded legs return null with DIV_ZERO_GUARD. Full provenance in the manifest description.

combinedTaxRate.description: Combined effective tax rate, percent (default 28; >=100 guards to null legs).

annualChildcareCost.description: Annual childcare cost per child, USD/yr (default 25000).

incomeGrowthRate.description: Annual growth rate, percent, for the 10-year opportunity leg (default 3).

geoBNewSalary.description: Partner B post-move salary, USD/yr; 0 = no job lined up (default 65000).

tab1.description: Childcare break-even leg: totalChildcare, childcareBreakevenSalary (null when combinedTaxRate >= 100), netContribution, householdNetBothWorking, householdNetOneStops, netHouseholdGainFromBothWorking, verdicts {belowBreakEven, netPositive}.

tab2.description: Sabbatical leg: directIncomeLost, matchLost, opportunityCost10yr, totalTrueCost, verdicts {substantialCost}.

tab3.description: Relocation leg: currentHousehold, newHousehold, nominalChange, nominalPct, colAdjustedChange, colPct, breakEvenMonths (null unless Partner B takes a cut), verdicts {nominalGain, colGain, colTrap, partnerBCut, partnerBNoJob}.

compliance_flags.description: DIV_ZERO_GUARD appears when a guard branch engaged (taxRate >= 100, currentHousehold == 0, or destCOL == 0); Apex has no such guard and would emit Infinity/NaN.

input_schema_provenance: Each property is exactly the policy_parameters member the kernel reads; there is no other input surface. Five are required and gate Apex execution: calculateTab1 returns early unless both salaries are nonzero, calculateTab2 unless the sabbatical salary is nonzero, calculateTab3 unless the Partner A current/new salary pair is nonzero. All other inputs carry Apex || fallbacks (28, 1, 100, 12, 4, 3, 100, 100) mirrored by the kernel num() defaults; asOf is optional (null when absent).
